cases.question: Does an attribute ID always survive?
cases.source_evidence: Returned attribute IDs can differ; source and article retain this behavior. Other contracts match attribute ID and survives.
cases.cause_or_limit: Transaction/routine context absent; no factual omission established.

cases.question: Does every operation use this check?
cases.source_evidence: INV_ValidateSerialNums contract limits checks by item tracking and location class; not every transaction is covered.
cases.cause_or_limit: Question does not identify serial checking or a routine.

cases.question: Can return zero be treated as no changes?
cases.source_evidence: Article preserves zero for guard rejection and for normal COMMIT followed by the rowcount return.
cases.cause_or_limit: Question does not name the wave routine; similar return-code interpretation exists elsewhere.

cases.question: Are NULL historical quantities treated as zero?
cases.source_evidence: Included-slot NULL propagation and SUM behavior remain in article boundaries and CompleteWave_UpdateOdrDtlCond contract.
cases.cause_or_limit: Question lacks order/wave context. NULL/quantity terms match multiple contracts.

cases.question: Does Ready prove the label printed?
cases.source_evidence: TRAV_EX01_ReprintPS contract distinguishes Ready request insertion from downstream printing; article requires downstream/printer evidence.
cases.cause_or_limit: Related label guidance ranks higher; no source omission established.

cases.question: Does this call a carrier to rate the shipment?
cases.source_evidence: Main article and SHP_UpdateFreightCharges contract explicitly say no carrier-rating request occurs.
cases.cause_or_limit: This does not identify a routine.

cases.question: Does it select only TREE_UNIT roots?
cases.source_evidence: Article specifies PARENT_CONTAINER_ID text rather than tree-root metadata.
cases.cause_or_limit: Question identifies TREE_UNIT terminology but not the freight routine; tree articles match more strongly.

cases.question: Does this check warehouse access?
cases.source_evidence: Article and IsWorkZoneAuthorized contract explicitly deny establishing warehouse access.
cases.cause_or_limit: This check does not identify the zone function.

cases.question: Are root containers restricted to item-bearing identified cartons?
cases.source_evidence: SHIPMENT_HEADER_VIEW contract defines roots solely as PARENT IS NULL, without identifier/status/item filtering.
cases.cause_or_limit: process-item receives a name boost from item-bearing. Intent ambiguity reproduced, but no safe narrow correction established.

cases.question: Does COMPLETE prove the work order finished?
cases.source_evidence: COMPLETE is an alias for requested build quantity, not completion. Both process-work-order and its contained process-work receive name boosts.
cases.cause_or_limit: Contained generic Work name boost pushes expected view to rank 9; suppress only fully contained occurrences, preserving independent mentions.

cases.question: Does every numeric-looking data type get summed?
cases.source_evidence: Main article retains exactly-numeric type selection for SUM and otherwise COUNT.
cases.cause_or_limit: Generic data/type/get words produce incidental matches; dashboard/metric context is absent.

cases.question: Why might a cycle-count request appear more than once?
cases.source_evidence: Main article and heading explain inventory-join repetition.
cases.cause_or_limit: Multiplicity guidance and other cycle-count contracts rank higher; factual meaning remains present.
